scenarios.title: A｜火警
scenarios.setting: 在“酒店突发事故”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“火警”。

turns.text: Attention, please. The fire alarm has been activated. Please leave the building using the nearest emergency exit. Do not use the elevators.

turns.prompt: 你想确认火警情况和安全离开的方式，会怎么说？

choices.text: Is this a real emergency?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is this a real emergency?
feedback.explanation: “emergency”指紧急情况，表明需要及时处理。

choices.text: Where is the nearest emergency exit?

feedback.naturalExpression: Where is the nearest emergency exit?
feedback.explanation: “exit”指出口，可与编号或地标一起说明位置。

choices.text: Should I leave the building now?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I leave the building now?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Where should we go once we’re outside?

feedback.naturalExpression: Where should we go once we’re outside?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Can I take the elevator?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Is this a real emergency?
feedback.explanation: 这句语法成立，但当前广播已要求不要使用电梯；回应需要围绕楼梯和疏散路线。

turns.text: Please use the stairs and leave the building immediately.

turns.prompt: 你想确认位置或前往的路线，会怎么问？

choices.text: Which way are the stairs?

feedback.naturalExpression: Which way are the stairs?
feedback.explanation: 从具体线路或方向中确认一个选择，能减少走错或搭错车的可能。

choices.text: Should I take anything with me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I take anything with me?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Where is the meeting point?

feedback.naturalExpression: Where is the meeting point?
feedback.explanation: 把需要的信息限定为地点或位置，适合请人指路或定位物品。

choices.text: Can I go back to my room for my passport?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Which way are the stairs?
feedback.explanation: 这句是在提出返回房间；当前应跟随疏散安排，不适合把取证件作为下一步。

turns.text: The stairs are to your left. Please don’t return to your room. Go directly outside.

turns.prompt: 关于「酒店突发事故」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Understood. I’ll go now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Understood. I’ll go now.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Okay. Where should I wait outside?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Where should I wait outside?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Got it. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

turns.text: Please gather across the street at the designated meeting point.

scenarios.title: B｜房间漏水
scenarios.setting: 在“酒店突发事故”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“房间漏水”。

turns.prompt: 你想描述遇到的故障并寻求处理，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, there’s water leaking into my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, there’s water leaking into my room.
feedback.explanation: “leaking”指正在泄漏；用于水管等设备时常指漏水。

choices.text: There’s a serious leak in my bathroom.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s a serious leak in my bathroom.
feedback.explanation: 用“there be”说明存在的事物或情况，先呈现事实，便于对方继续处理。

choices.text: Water is coming through the ceiling.

feedback.naturalExpression: Water is coming through the ceiling.
feedback.explanation: “through the ceiling”表示从天花板穿过或渗下，能明确漏水的来源方向。

choices.text: There’s water all over the bathroom floor.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s water all over the bathroom floor.
feedback.explanation: 用具体规格或位置回应对方，便于落实选择；上下文已明确时，不必重复整项需求。

choices.text: My room is leaking water everywhere.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, there’s water leaking into my room.
feedback.explanation: 这句能说明漏水严重；如果水从外面流进来，“water is leaking into my room”更准确地区分来源。

turns.text: I’m sorry. Is the water still coming in?

turns.prompt: 你想说明漏水目前的严重程度，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes, and it’s getting worse.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, and it’s getting worse.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: Yes. The floor is starting to flood.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. The floor is starting to flood.
feedback.explanation: 用具体规格或位置回应对方，便于落实选择；上下文已明确时，不必重复整项需求。

choices.text: It’s slowed down, but there’s already a lot of water.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s slowed down, but there’s already a lot of water.
feedback.explanation: “already”强调事情已经发生或完成，适合核对进度与时间先后。

choices.text: Yes, and some of my belongings are getting wet.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, and some of my belongings are getting wet.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

turns.text: Please stay away from any electrical outlets. We’ll send someone up immediately.

turns.prompt: 你想了解房间漏水时自己该怎样配合处理，会怎么说？

choices.text: Should I leave the room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I leave the room?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Do I need to turn anything off?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to turn anything off?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Should I take my belongings with me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I take my belongings with me?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Could you send someone up right away?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you send someone up right away?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

turns.text: Please take your essential belongings and wait in the hallway. We’ll arrange another room if necessary.

turns.prompt: 关于「酒店突发事故」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay, I’ll leave the room now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I’ll leave the room now.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Understood. I’ll wait outside.

feedback.naturalExpression: Understood. I’ll wait outside.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: C｜酒店停水 / 停电
scenarios.setting: 在“酒店突发事故”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“酒店停水 / 停电”。

turns.prompt: 关于「酒店突发事故」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, the power has gone out in my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, the power has gone out in my room.
feedback.explanation: “power has gone out”表示断电；与某一件设备单独坏掉不同。

choices.text: There’s no electricity in my room. Is there a power outage?

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s no electricity in my room. Is there a power outage?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: None of the lights or outlets are working.

feedback.naturalExpression: None of the lights or outlets are working.
feedback.explanation: “none of”表示所说范围里一个也没有，能说明问题涉及全部相关设备。

choices.text: There’s no running water in my room. Is there a problem with the water supply?

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s no running water in my room. Is there a problem with the water supply?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: The whole room has no power.

feedback.naturalExpression: The whole room has no power.
feedback.explanation: “has no power”表示断电；与某一件设备单独坏掉不同。

turns.text: Yes, I’m afraid there’s a temporary outage affecting several floors.

turns.prompt: 你想进一步确认时间，会怎么问？

choices.text: Do you know how long it will last?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know how long it will last?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: When do you expect the power to be back on?

feedback.naturalExpression: When do you expect the power to be back on?
feedback.explanation: 询问时间或时机，便于对方给出具体安排，减少对等待或操作时间的猜测。

choices.text: Is the whole hotel affected?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is the whole hotel affected?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Are the elevators still working?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are the elevators still working?
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

turns.text: We’re working on the problem. We expect the power to be restored within about thirty minutes.

turns.prompt: 你想确认停水或停电时留在哪里比较合适，会怎么说？

choices.text: Is it safe to stay in the room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is it safe to stay in the room?
feedback.explanation: “stay in”指待在家、不外出，适合聊休闲偏好。

choices.text: Should I come down to the lobby?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I come down to the lobby?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Will you let us know when the power is back?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will you let us know when the power is back?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: What should I do if it isn’t restored soon?

feedback.naturalExpression: What should I do if it isn’t restored soon?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

turns.text: It’s safe to stay in your room. We’ll notify all guests once the power is restored.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: All right. Thank you for the update.

feedback.naturalExpression: All right. Thank you for the update.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Okay. I’ll wait for the announcement. Thanks.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’ll wait for the announcement. Thanks.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: D｜酒店要求临时换房
scenarios.setting: 在“酒店突发事故”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“酒店要求临时换房”。

turns.text: Miss/Mr. Chen, I’m sorry, but there’s a maintenance problem affecting your room. We’ll need to move you to another room.

turns.prompt: 你想了解酒店要求临时换房的原因，会怎么说？

choices.text: What’s wrong with my room?

feedback.naturalExpression: What’s wrong with my room?
feedback.explanation: “what’s wrong”询问出了什么问题，适合在不清楚原因时先了解情况。

choices.text: Is there a serious problem?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a serious problem?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Do I have to move right away?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I have to move right away?
feedback.explanation: “have to”表示有必要或受条件限制必须这样做，可用于核实办理要求。

choices.text: How long will I need to stay in the other room?

feedback.naturalExpression: How long will I need to stay in the other room?
feedback.explanation: “stay in”指待在家、不外出，适合聊休闲偏好。

choices.text: Why I need to change my room?

feedback.naturalExpression: What’s wrong with my room?
feedback.explanation: 直接问原因需要“Why do I need …?”；不能省略助动词“do”。

turns.text: There’s a plumbing issue, and maintenance needs access to the room. Unfortunately, it can’t be fixed tonight.

turns.prompt: 你想确认酒店准备安排的新房间条件，会怎么说？

choices.text: What kind of room will I be moved to?

feedback.naturalExpression: What kind of room will I be moved to?
feedback.explanation: “kind of”口语中表示有点、算是，常用来缓和对自身或事情的描述。

choices.text: Is the new room the same type as my current one?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is the new room the same type as my current one?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Will I have to pay anything extra?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will I have to pay anything extra?
feedback.explanation: “have to”表示有必要或受条件限制必须这样做，可用于核实办理要求。

choices.text: Is the new room on the same floor?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is the new room on the same floor?
feedback.explanation: “same floor”明确楼层，能减少指路或换房时的位置误会。

turns.text: We’ve arranged a larger room on the tenth floor at no additional charge.

turns.prompt: 你想了解时间安排或需要等多久，会怎么问？

choices.text: That sounds fine. When do I need to move?

feedback.naturalExpression: That sounds fine. When do I need to move?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Okay. Could someone help me with my luggage?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Could someone help me with my luggage?
feedback.explanation: “luggage”指行李的统称，通常不可数；数量可用“pieces of luggage”。

choices.text: Will my current key card still work?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will my current key card still work?
feedback.explanation: “key card”指房卡，即开门用的卡片。

choices.text: Could you give me a little time to pack my things?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you give me a little time to pack my things?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

turns.text: Of course. Take your time. We can send someone up to help with your luggage.

turns.prompt: 你想和酒店商量换房时搬运行李的安排，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you. Could you send someone up in about fifteen minutes?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. Could you send someone up in about fifteen minutes?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Great. I’ll pack my things now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’ll pack my things now.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Thanks. Where should I pick up the new key card?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. Where should I pick up the new key card?
feedback.explanation: “key card”指房卡，即开门用的卡片。

turns.text: We’ll bring the new key card up with the bell attendant.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Perfect. Thank you for arranging everything.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Thank you for arranging everything.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: All right. I appreciate your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: All right. I appreciate your help.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。
